rootCause: A deployed task definition revision enabled the leaky read path, so each patient vital request acquired a database session that was never returned and connections grew steadily until the pool was exhausted.

remediation.summary: Release the leaked connections by redeploying the Healthcare service, then roll the task definition back to the revision whose session pool behaviour was intact.

safeguards.preconditions: Confirm the deployed revision enables the leak flag and that the previous revision did not.
safeguards.approval: Require the service owner to approve the redeploy and the revision rollback.
safeguards.rollback: Redeploy the current revision if vital ingest does not recover after the rollback.
safeguards.verification: Verify that DatabaseConnections stops climbing and VitalIngestFailures returns to zero while ingest attempts stay flat.
